finish.summary:
I built a 2.5-cell organizer, about 487 × 374 × 114 mm, from 31 parts. check_build found no rule issues and no mesh clashes.

- **Bins:** two lift-out half-depth bins, each split into 3 compartments, hold M3 screws, nuts and standoffs.
- **Drawer:** one drawer on the cut face of the half base, staged with tweezers.
- **Handle:** the carry handle sits on a lid over the middle cell, so it's centred over the body.

Two things to know:
- The middle bin is under that handle lid. You get to it by lifting the lid, so the parts in it can't be seen from outside.
- I tried putting the screw, nut and standoff heaps and a solder reel in the drawer, but the configurator wouldn't place them, so only the tweezers are in it.

All open faces have end caps and the joints are bolted. The configurator only checks fit, so whether the handle and joints can carry the box when it's full isn't checked here.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
